Woman Avoids Jail for Fatal XL Bully Attack on Cousin

A woman has been sentenced for her role in the death of her 19-year-old cousin, who was killed by an out-of-control XL Bully dog. The incident involved the dog attacking the young man. The woman was given a sentence that allowed her to avoid jail time. Details of the specific sentence and the circumstances leading to the dog attack were not provided in the coverage.
